title: Goldman-Backed Biotech Attovia Seeks $212.5 Million in US IPO
summary: Attovia Therapeutics Inc., an early-stage drug developer focused on immune-mediated diseases with high unmet need, is seeking to raise as much as $212.5 million in a US initial public offering.

title: NZ Markets Watchdog CEO on Leave as Workplace Culture Reviewed
summary: New Zealand’s financial markets watchdog has appointed an interim chief executive after Samantha Barrass went on leave following revelations of “cultural concerns” in the workplace.

title: From Food to Football: How Clouse Came to the Commanders
summary: Washington Commanders President Mark Clouse talks about why he left the Campbell's Company as CEO to take this job. He speaks to Bloomberg's Randall Williams at a Newsmakers event in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Can We Trust Election Prediction Markets?
summary: Leading prediction markets have been heralded as “truth machines” — arenas for mass betting that reveal what people really think when they’ve got money on the line. But a new Bloomberg investigation has found evidence that these markets are vulnerable to manipulation. On today’s Big Take podcast, host Sarah Holder and Bloomberg investigative reporter Liam Vaughan dig into what can happen when prediction markets mix with politics.  (Source: Bloomberg)
